title: LUMIÈRE — THE GALA
subtitle: 50 ASSETS LOGGED
shortDescription: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering held its branch entry programme "Lumière – The Gala" on 29 October 2025 at the Kalam Auditorium.
description: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering held its branch entry programme "Lumière – The Gala" on 29 October 2025 at the Kalam Auditorium.
Organised by the Cipher Association, the programme welcomed first-year students into the department through the theme "Where Glam Meets Glow."
The venue featured coordinated red, gold and black décor, floral arrangements, illuminated panels and a central Lumière backdrop.
The event encouraged interaction among students and showcased the role of Cipher in building an active student community beyond academics.

title: PROMPT OPS–2K26
subtitle: AI SPEC PROTOCOL
shortDescription: Organised jointly by AgentBlazer Club and Cipher under the guidance of Ms. Nisha J Roche, Ms. Jaishma K and HOD Dr. Melwyn D'Souza.
description: Organised jointly by AgentBlazer Club and Cipher under the guidance of Ms. Nisha J Roche, Ms. Jaishma K and HOD Dr. Melwyn D'Souza.
Track 1 challenged first-year students in invitation generation, logo recreation and image recreation using AI modalities.
Track 2 tested advanced JSON conversion, Python debugging and Gemini AI security prompt extraction.
The competition promoted prompt engineering, AI literacy and practical problem solving across emerging LLM paradigms.
